meta.name: multi-agent-meeting
meta.description: 模拟多个AI智能体协作开会并进行决策讨论的场景。适用于需要从多个专业角度分析问题、进行辩论和达成共识的场景，如项目决策、技术方案评审、商业策略制定等。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让多个AI智能体协作开会并做出决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从多角度分析问题并达成共识
copy.tagline_en: Simulate multi-agent meetings for collaborative decision-making
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze problems from multiple perspectives and reach consensus

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会模拟多个不同专业背景的 AI 智能体开会：你给主题和目标，它自动配置3-5个角色，按开场、讨论、辩论、收敛、决策五阶段推进，全程展示发言，最后输出含决策结论、论据、风险提示和后续行动的会议记录。
howto.when: 当你说要开项目决策会、技术方案评审或商业策略讨论等需要多角度分析问题时触发。

say.text: 请模拟一次会议，讨论是否采用微服务架构。
say.note: 它会配置技术架构师等角色并输出完整会议记录。

say.text: 组织一场新产品定价策略的多智能体会议。
say.note: 自动生成产品经理、财务顾问等角色进行辩论。

say.text: 召集项目风险评估会议，给出应对建议。
say.note: 输出风险清单及后续行动建议。

howto.what_en: Claude simulates a multi-agent meeting. Given a topic, it creates 3-5 roles, runs discussion/debate/decision phases in real time, and outputs a record with conclusions, arguments, risks, and next actions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need multi-angle analysis, such as project decisions, technical solution reviews, or business strategy discussions, etc.

say_en.text: Run a simulated meeting on whether to adopt microservices.
say_en.note: Roles like tech architect will be configured.

say_en.text: Hold a multi-agent meeting for a new product pricing strategy.
say_en.note: Product manager and financial advisor will debate.

say_en.text: Convene a project risk assessment meeting with recommendations.
say_en.note: Outputs risk list and action items.
